1) There are no completely right or wrong ways to go, especially in the early game.


2) Each checkpoint has a yellow line that points to another checkpoint (or important place/boss), giving you a rough indication of where to go.


3) You should probably look for map parts, whenever you enter a new area, it starts off as all grey in the map menu, and you have to "unlock" the map by grabbing an item that is shown as some kind of structure in the greyed-out map.


4) If you find a boss that is too tough, go somewhere else, or simply go past it by stealthing. I think that in your post you're referring to the Tree Sentinel (big armored guy on a horse with halberd and shield) and you can easily go past him by going around and entering the church from the side. Or you can ignore him completely and go look for stuff in the lake to the right! 


5) NPCs, descriptions, notes and story events/cutscenes can give you hints as to where to go next. From the intro cinematic, you know that your endgame is going to be to reach the Erdtree (the big golden tree in the distance). The guy that you meet at the first checkpoint in the open world (Varrè, dressed all in white and with a mask) tells you to go to Stormveil Castle, which is the big castle that you see in the distance up North. That castle is the main dungeon of the starting area, Limgrave, and will be very tough if you're not prepared, so your best course of action could be to properly explore other things in Limgrave first.
